summary: Repeat-inquiry client who came in asking to get a TikTok account banned (takedown of @vrlll999). Initially quoted $750 for one profile with a 24-48hr turnaround, then came back on 8/28 having found a second active profile and negotiated both for $1200, paid via Zelle to 5618011087 on 8/28. As of 9/01 the accounts are still up and he is following up asking for a status update — outstanding delivery obligation, needs a response.
key_facts: Target TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@vrlll999 (plus a second profile found 8/28, both active)
First quote: $750 for one takedown, 24-48hr turnaround
Final deal: both profiles for $1200 (he asked for $1000, countered at $1200)
Paid via Zelle to 5618011087 on 2026-08-28; order submitted same day
His Apple Pay was locked, so payment came from a different number
Asked whether the ban would be permanent; told yes unless the target has a permanent ban rep
2026-09-01: accounts still live, client chasing for an update — service undelivered
